sub_graphs.title: EIP-7002: Withdrawal Request Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of validator withdrawal requests from submission to consensus layer processing

nodes.label: Withdrawal Intent Formed
nodes.description: Withdrawal credential holder decides to initiate withdrawal

nodes.label: Query Current Fee
nodes.description: Call predeploy contract with empty calldata to get current withdrawal fee

nodes.label: Current Fee Known
nodes.description: Caller knows the current dynamic withdrawal request fee

nodes.label: Submit Withdrawal Request
nodes.description: Send 56-byte input to predeploy contract with validator pubkey and amount

nodes.label: Validate Fee Payment
nodes.description: Contract verifies msg.value >= current_fee

nodes.label: Fee Insufficient
nodes.description: Transaction value does not cover withdrawal fee

nodes.label: Fee Valid
nodes.description: Transaction value covers withdrawal fee

nodes.label: Add Request to Queue
nodes.description: Withdrawal request added to in-state queue buffer

nodes.label: Request Queued
nodes.description: Withdrawal request stored in predeploy contract queue

nodes.label: System Call Dequeues Requests
nodes.description: Post-block system call retrieves up to 16 requests from queue

nodes.label: Request in Execution Payload
nodes.description: Withdrawal request included in ExecutionPayload for consensus layer

nodes.label: Consensus Layer Processes Request
nodes.description: Consensus layer validates and processes withdrawal request like voluntary exit

nodes.label: Withdrawal Initiated
nodes.description: Validator exit or partial withdrawal has been initiated on consensus layer

external_entities.name: Withdrawal Credential Owner
external_entities.description: EOA or smart contract holding 0x01 withdrawal credentials for a validator

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7002: Dynamic Fee Pricing
sub_graphs.description: Models the EIP-1559-style dynamic fee mechanism for withdrawal requests

nodes.label: Excess Requests Tracked
nodes.description: System tracks excess withdrawal requests above target rate

nodes.label: Compute Current Fee
nodes.description: Calculate fee using exponential formula: MIN_FEE * e^(excess / UPDATE_FRACTION)

nodes.label: Fee at Minimum
nodes.description: Current fee equals MIN_WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_FEE (1 wei)

nodes.label: Fee Elevated
nodes.description: Fee above minimum due to excess demand

nodes.label: Update Excess Counter
nodes.description: Adjust excess based on requests vs target (2 per block)

nodes.label: Excess Increased
nodes.description: More requests than target, excess grows

nodes.label: Excess Decreased
nodes.description: Fewer requests than target, excess shrinks

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7002: Withdrawal Queue Management
sub_graphs.description: Models the in-state queue that buffers withdrawal requests between execution and consensus layers

nodes.label: Queue Empty
nodes.description: No pending withdrawal requests in queue

nodes.label: Queue Has Requests
nodes.description: One or more withdrawal requests pending in queue

nodes.label: Enqueue Request
nodes.description: Add new withdrawal request to queue tail

nodes.label: Dequeue Batch
nodes.description: Remove up to MAX_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTS_PER_BLOCK (16) from queue head

nodes.label: Queue Partially Drained
nodes.description: Some requests remain after dequeue operation

nodes.label: Queue Fully Drained
nodes.description: All pending requests dequeued this block

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7002: Trust and Security Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models trust boundaries and security considerations for withdrawal requests

nodes.label: Request Received by Contract
nodes.description: Predeploy contract receives withdrawal request call

nodes.label: Validate Caller
nodes.description: Record msg.sender as source_address for authorization check

nodes.label: Validate Input Format
nodes.description: Verify input is exactly 56 bytes (pubkey + amount)

nodes.label: Input Invalid
nodes.description: Input does not match expected 56-byte format

nodes.label: Input Valid
nodes.description: Input format is correct

nodes.label: CL Validates Withdrawal Credentials
nodes.description: Consensus layer verifies source_address matches validator's withdrawal credentials

nodes.label: Credentials Mismatch
nodes.description: Source address does not match validator's 0x01 withdrawal credentials

nodes.label: Credentials Valid
nodes.description: Source address authorized to control this validator

external_entities.name: External Caller
external_entities.description: EOA or smart contract calling the withdrawal predeploy contract

ambiguities.text: The specification states 'exact fees cannot be predetermined' but does not specify the maximum time between fee query and transaction inclusion.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume smart contracts should query fees in the same transaction as submission (via static call) and implement slippage protection with a maximum fee parameter.

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify behavior when the predeploy contract is called with calldata between 0 and 56 bytes (exclusive).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume any calldata that is not exactly 0 bytes (fee query) or 56 bytes (withdrawal request) results in transaction failure or no-op.

ambiguities.text: The term 'partial withdrawal' is used without specifying minimum or maximum amounts.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume partial withdrawals follow existing consensus layer rules for minimum and maximum withdrawal amounts.

implicit_assumptions.description: The predeploy contract at address 0x00000961Ef480Eb55e80D19ad83579A64c007002 is correctly deployed and immutable.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Block validation fails, potential chain halt or fork if contract is missing or corrupted at activation.

implicit_assumptions.description: Existing custody arrangements relying on withdrawal credentials not being able to trigger exits have been renegotiated or migrated.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Trust relationships violated, potential for unauthorized validator exits by withdrawal credential holders.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot spam withdrawal requests indefinitely due to the exponential fee mechanism.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Griefing attack possible if attacker has sufficient ETH, causing legitimate users to face prohibitive fees.

implicit_assumptions.description: The consensus layer will process withdrawal requests within a bounded time, preventing indefinite queuing.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unbounded queue growth could lead to state bloat and degraded performance.
